frame_indexing: All absolute frame numbers come from my own raw dumps (bin/dump.sh seeks to (F-0.25)/24, so ffmpeg lands on frame F exactly; cross-checked against a full-video 192x108 decode: the minimum difference falls on the same index). Strips were started at (F-0.25)/24 or at exact multiples of 1/24, so the old kit off-by-one (round vs ceil) does not affect them. The only exception was an early overview strip a1.jpg (start 39.8 s, labels one frame low), which was used for orientation only. Audio offsets are computed from sample index = frame/24 directly. No run used the fixed kit; none needed it. The D exit fit job (D1x) was killed externally after frame 5885; frames 5886+ are after the camera cut and are not needed.
measured_by: layer fit per frame: frame = ref + a*blur_sx,sy(warp_s,dx,dy(final-ref)) on each text line

recipe.units: frames @24fps; k = 0 is the FIRST frame on which the line is visible (opacity ~0.02-0.03). translateY in em of the line font-size (+ = down). Keyframe the tween to START at k = -0.5.

keyframes.scale: none measurable (0.992-0.996 on k=0..2 only, within fit noise) -> keep 1.0
keyframes.translateX: none (|dx| <= 2.5 px on k=0, 0 from k=3; noise)

ease_fits.note: start time and from-offset trade off against each other because the line is invisible before k=0; alternative fit with start -1.0: duration 7.75 f, from 0.381 em, bezier(0.255,0.507,0.374,0.940), rms 0.00052 em. Both reproduce every visible frame.

variant_RISE_standard.blur_rule: blur is directional (y >> x) and tracks velocity: sigma_y ~= velocity_px_per_frame / sqrt(12) (box blur one full frame of travel = 360-degree shutter motion blur). Implement as motion blur, or as filter blur on y only.

translateY_F.note: k=0 value (-0.304 em) excluded: opacity 0.01 there, dy unreliable

keyframes.opacity_line1_CPL: see per_frame E1: 0.016 at k0 ... 0.90 at k11, 1.0 at k19

ease_fits.translateY_E1_px: from about -28.7 px (0.24 em) to 0 over ~12.4 f, strong ease-out (bezier 0.076,0.894,0.750,0.945; rms 0.075 px)

line_stagger.rule: line 2 uses the SAME tween as line 1, offset by N frames; N measured = 1 (A), 2 (B), 0 (D), 7 (E), 5 (F), 2 (G), 14 (H), 2 (I). Median 2 f. N is NOT constant; long delays (H, E) look speech-paced (H: line 2 lands as "organic" is spoken).
line_stagger.order: top line first, always (also when the top line is the pink one: E, I)
line_stagger.within_line: no per-word or per-letter stagger: every word of a line moves and fades in lockstep (fit residual < 0.04 with one rigid layer per line)

hold.rule: static: zero motion, zero scale drift during hold (C: frame diff 0.0 for 30 f). Only the pink gradient fill keeps animating.

exit.default: hard cut: the text disappears in one frame with no fade/scale/move. Usually the camera cut removes it (C, E, F, G, H, I).
exit.variant_hard_cut_mid_shot: A, B: text cut out mid-shot after exactly 35 visible frames (A 5 f before the camera cut, B 56 f before).
exit.variant_slide_up_fade: D: translateY 0 -> -22.5 px (-0.24 em) over 9 f, ease ~ cubic-bezier(0.241,-0.063,0.733,1.116) (start k-0.5, 10.4 f, rms 0.005 of progress), then opacity 1.0 -> 0.20 -> 0.02 in the last 2 frames, gone on the camera cut frame.

recipe.camera_cut_relation: Entrance is independent of cuts: first visible frame is 0-2 f after a cut (B +2), or 30-80 f into the shot (A, C, D, E, F), or 2 f BEFORE the cut and continuing across it (G).
recipe.speech_relation: first visible frame leads the matching spoken word by ~140-300 ms (B "what" +138 ms, G "What" +137 ms, I "AB" +167 ms, D "video" +270 ms; YouTube auto-caption word times, +/-100 ms).

evidence: Rendered candidates with ffmpeg drawtext and scored IoU against the reference glyph masks: Space Grotesk 700 ranks #1 on every flat (frontal) line: KEEP IT SIMPLE 0.924, COST PER LEAD 0.921, HOW TO 0.921, FIND CLIENTS 0.838, A/B 0.826; and on SAVE THE / BUDGET / TEST THE (per-word).
Perspective lines (WHAT TO, WHAT ABOUT, ORGANIC FIRST) score lower for every font because of the rotateY keystone; visual overlay still matches Space Grotesk letter-for-letter.

Letterform tells: W with near-vertical outer strokes and thin inner V; B and D with the flat spur/notch at the stem-bowl junction (reads as a slab - this is why BUDGET looked "monospace/slab"); G with spur + horizontal bar; R with straight leg; S with flat horizontal terminals; round "?" dot.
Width/height ratio of each word within 1-5% of Space Grotesk 700 at default spacing (render/ref aspect 1.01-1.05).

rejected.IBM Plex Mono 700 / Space Mono 700 (for: pink word is proportional, not monospaced; Space Grotesk 700 IoU 0.448 > mono faces on BUDGET
rejected.Inter 800, Host Grotesk 800, Familjen Gr: W/B/D/G shapes differ; lower IoU on flat lines

alternates: Space Grotesk 600 (IoU 0.01-0.04 lower; slightly too light)
Familjen Grotesk 700 (similar W, but no B/D spur)

typography.two_tone_rule: one line white, the punch line (the keyword) pink-gradient. Usually line 2 is pink (A, B, F, G, H); for an acronym/metric the pink word is line 1 and set ~1.8x larger (E: CPL 119 px over COST PER LEAD 67 px; I: A/B 104 px over TEST 55 px). Some cards are white-only (C, D).

size_px_at_1080p.rule: scales with shot: ~129-131 px (cap 88-94 px) on the close 3/4 shot (A, B); ~86-97 px (cap 60-67) on 3/4 medium (D, G); ~65-79 px (cap 44-54) on frontal wide (C, E2, F, H); emphasised acronym line 104-119 px.

typography.tracking: about -0.017 em (-1 px at 65 px): reference words are 2-5% narrower than default-spaced Space Grotesk 700 (C -0.016 em, E2 -0.017, F1 -0.015, F2 -0.017, I2 -0.019). Word space normal.
typography.line_height: gap between line-1 baseline and line-2 cap top = 0.38-0.42 em (A 0.42, B 0.40, D 0.40, F 0.38) -> CSS line-height ~1.10 for same-size lines. H uses a looser gap (~1.2 em pitch 1.6).
typography.alignment: centre-aligned in A, B, D, E; left-aligned in C, F, G, H, I.

pink_gradient.note: animated multi-stop fill, not a flat colour. Stops seen (flattest interior pixels): red #FA0030/#FD0239, hot pink #FF1270 / #FD1267 (median of BUDGET), pink-magenta #F84187 / #FF50B2, peach #FF8A70 / #FBA285, yellow #FFE972 / #FDE86B.
pink_gradient.yellow_end: large acronym words (CPL, A/B) and FIND CLIENTS carry a yellow-peach end (#FFE972) on the RIGHT end / last letter
pink_gradient.animation: the fill drifts continuously during entrance AND hold: e.g. BUDGET right end goes #FB606C (k8) -> #FE7E79 peach (k13) -> #FB1577 pink (k34); left end red -> pink. Kymographs show soft blobs of red/peach/white-pink sliding along the word over ~0.5-1 s; geometry (linear vs mesh) not resolvable. Recommend: linear-gradient(90deg, #FF1470 0%, #FF0035 35%, #FF1A75 70%, #FF7A78 90%, #FFE872 100%) with background-position animated ~ -30% -> +30% over ~1.5 s (low confidence).

shadow.A,B (early cards): soft dark drop shadow: gaussian sigma 16 px (CSS blur ~32 px), offset x -4 px, y +6 px, black at ~0.65 opacity (linear-light darkening fit, rmse 0.022 vs bg std 0.073). ~text-shadow: -4px 6px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.65).
shadow.C, D, E, F, H, I: NO shadow or glow (background darkening 0.00 at 3-105 px from glyph edges).
shadow.glow: no outer glow measured on any instance incl. CPL ("glowing" impression comes from the bright yellow-pink gradient, not a blur halo).

typography.perspective: On 3/4 side-angle shots (A, B, D, H) each line is keystoned as if lying on the wall plane: right edge cap-height 0.93-0.96 x the left edge, line 1 tilts down to the right (+0.6..0.9 deg top edge), line 2 tilts up (-0.5..-1.3 deg) -> horizon between the lines ~y 330, vanishing point to the right. Frontal shots (C, E, F, I) are flat. Use the per-line quads (TL,TR,BR,BL) as matrix3d targets; approx CSS: perspective 1000px + rotateY 4-7 deg with the right edge receding.
typography.position_rule: text sits on the empty wall LEFT of the presenter, block centre x 0.11-0.34, y 0.23-0.36 of frame, always upper-left quadrant, never overlapping the head. Left-aligned cards start at x 0.057-0.08 (frontal) / 0.08-0.21 (3/4).

sfx.measured: No consistent transient at the first visible frame. Across 11 entrances the mid-channel 6-16 kHz band shows a soft broadband swell (bell envelope ~120-200 ms) peaking BEFORE the first visible frame in 6/11 cases: A -75 ms, D -110 ms, G -80 ms, H -55 ms, E2 -100 ms, H2 -125 ms (median about -90 ms, i.e. the sound leads by ~2 frames). B -230, I -235, C +85, F +10, E +195 do not fit.
sfx.interpretation: consistent with a quiet whoosh that leads the text by ~2 frames, but it overlaps speech sibilants, so it cannot be separated from voice; the side channel is dominated by AAC joint-stereo artefacts; template cross-correlation found no reused identical sample (best repeat NCC 0.29).
sfx.recommendation: if an SFX is used: soft whoosh, onset ~ -170 ms, peak ~ -90 ms relative to the first visible frame, low level (~ -20 dB under voice). Confidence low.

confidence.opacity per frame: high (+/-0.01) where opacity > 0.1; pink lines less (fill colour animation leaks into the opacity estimate: pink alpha creeps 0.92 -> 1.0 over the hold; use the white line of the same card as truth).
confidence.translateY per frame: high (+/-0.5 px) for opacity > 0.15; unreliable on the first visible frame (opacity < 0.05): those values are marked by low opacity.
confidence.blur sigma: medium (+/-0.5 px); separation from opacity weak at low opacity.
confidence.start offset before first visible frame: NOT measurable (invisible); -0.5 f assumed for the bezier fits; the from-offset (0.337 em) is the extrapolation, not a measurement.
confidence.font: high for Space Grotesk 700; weight 700 vs 600 is close (IoU gap 0.01-0.04).
confidence.gradient geometry/animation: low: stop colours are measured, the gradient shape and speed are an approximation.
confidence.G instance: timing only (no fit, no clean plate after the cut).
confidence.what would change it: a clean render of the template (After Effects/CapCut preset) or isolated SFX stems; a frame without text on the same shot for G and for the post-exit of A/B would tighten them.

instances.shot: 3/4 side-angle MCU (wall recedes; text in perspective)

exit.type: hard cut-out (1 frame, no fade/move) mid-shot
hard cut together with camera cut
slide UP 22.5 px over 9 f (eased), then 2-frame fade (1.0 -> 0.20 -> 0.02), ends 1 f before camera cut
hard cut with camera cut (to screen recording)

instances.note: Entrance STARTS 2 frames BEFORE the camera cut at 8512 and continues across it unchanged (graphic lives on the edit timeline, not on the shot). No clean background plate after the cut, so no per-frame fit; line-2 delay from threshold crossing (white 8514, pink 8516).
